domains.title: Development Paths
domains.description: Create, maintain, assign and complete development paths.

flows.title: Browse and search development paths
flows.description: Browse and search development paths in Mentingo.
preconditions: Learning paths are enabled and the account has path read access.
actions: Open Development Paths through application navigation.
Search for a path and inspect its available courses and selected language.
outcomes: Only paths available to this learner appear.

flows.title: Create a development path
flows.description: Create a development path in Mentingo.
preconditions: The account can create learning paths.
actions: Open development-path management.
Create a path with its title, description and other required metadata.
Save the new path.
outcomes: The new path appears and can be opened for editing.

flows.title: Edit development-path details
flows.description: Edit development-path details in Mentingo.
preconditions: The account can manage this path.
actions: Open the path editor from management.
Update its title, description or thumbnail.
Save the changes and reopen the path.
outcomes: Updated path details remain saved.

flows.title: Delete a development path
flows.description: Delete a development path in Mentingo.
preconditions: A disposable synthetic path exists and the account may delete it.
actions: Open the management actions for the disposable path.
Choose delete and complete the displayed confirmation.
outcomes: The deleted path is no longer listed.

flows.title: Add and edit path language versions
flows.description: Add and edit path language versions in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Add and edit path language versions.
preconditions: The account can manage this path and its languages.
actions: Open path editing and select a supported content language.
Enter the translated title and description.
Save and inspect the corresponding language view.
outcomes: The selected language displays its saved path metadata.

flows.title: Add courses to a development path
flows.description: Add courses to a development path in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Add courses to a development path.
preconditions: The account can update this path and eligible demo courses exist.
actions: Open the path course-management area.
Select existing eligible courses and add them to the path.
Save and inspect the path course list.
outcomes: The selected courses belong to the path.

flows.title: Reorder courses in a development path
flows.description: Reorder courses in a development path in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Reorder courses in a development path.
preconditions: The editable path contains multiple courses.
actions: Open path course management.
Move a course to another position using the provided ordering control.
Save and inspect the saved order.
outcomes: The path shows the new course order.

flows.title: Remove a course from a development path
flows.description: Remove a course from a development path in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Remove a course from a development path.
preconditions: The editable demo path contains a removable course.
actions: Open path course management.
Remove the selected course and save.
Review the remaining course list.
outcomes: The course is no longer a member of the path.

flows.title: Set draft, private and published path status
flows.description: Set draft, private and published path status in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Set draft, private and published path status.
preconditions: The account can update this path.
actions: Open the path publication controls.
Choose each supported visibility state for the synthetic path and save.
Inspect its status and the appropriate learner visibility.
outcomes: The selected publication state controls path availability.

flows.title: Require courses to be completed in order
flows.description: Require courses to be completed in order in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Require courses to be completed in order.
preconditions: The editable path contains multiple courses.
actions: Open path settings and enable sequence mode.
Save and open the path as an enrolled demo learner.
Inspect the first available course and the next locked course.
outcomes: Course access follows the configured sequence.

flows.title: Enroll individual learners in a path
flows.description: Enroll individual learners in a path in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Enroll individual learners in a path.
preconditions: The account has path-enrollment access and demo learners exist.
actions: Open path enrollment management.
Select individual learners and enroll them.
Review their enrollment and path access.
outcomes: Selected learners are enrolled and can access eligible path courses.

flows.title: Enroll a group in a path
flows.description: Enroll a group in a path in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Enroll a group in a path.
preconditions: The account can enroll paths and read the available demo groups.
actions: Open path group enrollment.
Select and enroll a demo group.
Review the group assignment and a member learner view.
outcomes: Eligible group members receive path access.

flows.title: Remove direct and group path enrollment
flows.description: Remove direct and group path enrollment in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Remove direct and group path enrollment.
preconditions: The account can manage enrollment on the demo path.
actions: Inspect direct and group enrollment for the path.
Remove the selected direct learner assignment or group enrollment.
Review the remaining enrollment paths.
outcomes: Only access no longer justified by another valid enrollment is removed.

flows.title: Self-enroll in an available path
flows.description: Self-enroll in an available path in Mentingo.
preconditions: A published path is available for learner self-enrollment.
actions: Open an eligible path as an unenrolled demo learner.
Choose the displayed enrollment action.
Open the first eligible course.
outcomes: The learner is enrolled in the path and can start its courses.

flows.title: Continue a path and inspect learning progress
flows.description: Continue a path and inspect learning progress in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Continue a path and inspect learning progress.
preconditions: The demo learner is enrolled in a path with recorded course progress.
actions: Open the enrolled path.
Inspect progress and continue an eligible course.
Complete the necessary demo course activity and return to the path.
outcomes: Path progress reflects completed courses and sequence access updates.

flows.title: Configure development-path certificates
flows.description: Enable development-path certificates and maintain their signature image.
flows.goal: Configure certificates and their signature image for a development path.
preconditions: The account can edit the development path.
actions: Open the development-path editor and enable certificates.
Upload a synthetic signature image and save the path.
Reopen the editor and confirm the certificate setting and signature remain saved.
Remove the signature image, save and verify it is removed.
outcomes: The path's certificate setting and signature changes remain saved.

flows.title: View and download a development-path certificate
flows.description: View and download a development-path certificate in Mentingo.
flows.goal: View and download a development-path certificate.
preconditions: The demo learner completed a certificate-enabled path.
actions: Open the earned path certificate.
Inspect its localized preview and download its PDF.
Use supported certificate sharing controls with synthetic data.
outcomes: The learner can access completion evidence for the path.

flows.title: Share a path with active recipient organizations
flows.description: Share a path with active recipient organizations in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Share a path with active recipient organizations.
preconditions: The account can export this path and an active synthetic recipient organization exists.
actions: Open path sharing.
Select an active recipient organization and start the transfer.
Inspect queued, processing and copied status; retry a recoverable failed transfer when displayed.
outcomes: The destination receives the shared path and linked courses; retries reuse the recipient path.

flows.title: Download a Mentingo development-path package
flows.description: Download a Mentingo development-path package in Mentingo.
preconditions: The account may manage this path and its synthetic course set.
actions: Open the path management actions.
Choose the Mentingo package download.
Wait for the supported export to produce its ZIP.
outcomes: A portable package contains the ordered path and managed course assets without learner progress.

flows.title: Import a Mentingo development-path package
flows.description: Import a Mentingo development-path package in Mentingo.
preconditions: The account may create paths and courses, and a synthetic path package exists.
actions: Open the package import dialog from Development Paths.
Choose the valid ZIP and start the import.
Wait for processing and open the imported draft path.
outcomes: The dialog completes and the destination owns draft copies with the preserved course order.

domains.title: Course Authoring
domains.description: Create and maintain courses, curriculum, publication, assignments and reusable packages.

flows.title: Find and filter manageable courses
flows.description: Find and filter manageable courses in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open the course list.
Search, sort and filter by the available category and status controls.
Open a manageable course.
outcomes: The selected course is available for authorized management.

flows.title: Create a draft course
flows.description: Create a draft course in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open new-course creation.
Choose a supported native course type and provide the required metadata.
Create the course and open its overview.
outcomes: A new draft belongs to the creator.

flows.title: Edit course metadata and learning outcomes
flows.description: Edit course metadata and learning outcomes in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Edit course metadata and learning outcomes.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open the course overview.
Edit its title, description, category and up to five learning outcomes in place.
Save and inspect the displayed details.
outcomes: The overview shows the saved course metadata.

flows.title: Set the course cover image and trailer
flows.description: Set the course cover image and trailer in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Set the course cover image and trailer.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open overview media editing.
Upload and reposition a synthetic cover image.
Add or replace the synthetic trailer and inspect the result.
outcomes: The selected cover and trailer appear in the course overview.

flows.title: Manage course language versions
flows.description: Manage course language versions in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Select the course content language in the overview.
Add or update translated metadata and learning outcomes.
Inspect missing-translation warnings and switch back to the base language.
outcomes: Language-specific edits remain independent and translation gaps are visible.

flows.title: Create, reorder, edit and remove curriculum chapters
flows.description: Create, reorder, edit and remove curriculum chapters in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Create, reorder, edit and remove curriculum chapters.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open curriculum editing from the course overview.
Add and rename chapters, then change their order.
Remove a disposable chapter using the displayed confirmation.
outcomes: The curriculum reflects the saved chapter structure.

flows.title: Create and maintain content lessons
flows.description: Create and maintain content lessons in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open a curriculum chapter and add a content lesson.
Edit rich text and attach synthetic media or resources.
Save, reopen and reorder the lesson; remove a separate disposable lesson.
outcomes: The saved curriculum contains the authored lesson and resources.

flows.title: Author quizzes and assessment rules
flows.description: Author quizzes and assessment rules in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Add a quiz lesson and supported question types.
Set passing score, attempts, cooldown and feedback options.
Edit question order and a language version, observing base-language structural restrictions.
Save and preview the quiz.
outcomes: The quiz contains its authored questions and completion rules.

flows.title: Import a SCORM course or lesson
flows.description: Import a SCORM course or lesson in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Import a SCORM course or lesson.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Choose SCORM course creation or add a SCORM lesson to a chapter.
Upload a valid synthetic SCORM ZIP and the required metadata.
Complete import and inspect the generated course or lesson, including a translated package when needed.
outcomes: The imported SCORM content is available in the draft curriculum.

flows.title: Add supported embed, AI mentor and live-training lessons
flows.description: Add supported embed, AI mentor and live-training lessons in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Add supported embed, AI mentor and live-training lessons.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open the chapter lesson picker.
Choose the supported lesson type and supply its required configuration using synthetic data.
Save and inspect the authored lesson; clearly show any service prerequisite.
outcomes: The selected lesson type is configured and available for preview.

flows.title: Publish a course or return it to private or draft
flows.description: Publish a course or return it to private or draft in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Publish a course or return it to private or draft.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open course settings.
Choose published, private or draft status and save each demonstrated state.
Inspect the status and learner availability.
outcomes: Course visibility follows the saved publication state.

flows.title: Archive, restore and delete eligible draft courses
flows.description: Archive, restore and delete eligible draft courses in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Archive, restore and delete eligible draft courses.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Archive a synthetic course and inspect its removal from discovery.
Restore it and confirm enrolled learners retain their progress.
Return a disposable course to draft and complete its deletion confirmation.
outcomes: Archive preserves enrolled access; eligible draft deletion removes the disposable course.

flows.title: Apply supported actions to multiple courses
flows.description: Apply supported actions to multiple courses in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Apply supported actions to multiple courses.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Select multiple manageable demo courses in the list.
Apply a shared category or publication status change.
Demonstrate archive or eligible draft deletion with appropriate synthetic records.
outcomes: The selected courses reflect the requested bulk changes.

flows.title: Configure sequencing and course behavior
flows.description: Configure sequencing and course behavior in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open the course behavior settings.
Configure lesson order, video completion and available repeat-learning options.
Save and inspect the corresponding learner experience.
outcomes: The course follows the saved completion and sequencing rules.

flows.title: Configure certificate issuance, appearance and validity
flows.description: Configure certificate issuance, appearance and validity in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Configure certificate issuance, appearance and validity.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open certificate settings and preview the certificate.
Enable issuance, choose font color and upload or remove a synthetic signature.
Configure validity and inspect the impact confirmation before applying it.
outcomes: The certificate configuration and applicable validity policy are saved.

flows.title: Reset selected course certificates
flows.description: Reset selected course certificates in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open certificate reset controls for the synthetic course.
Select all holders, groups or individual holders and choose whether to notify them.
Confirm the reset and inspect its displayed result.
outcomes: Selected certificates are archived and affected progress follows the reset rules.

flows.title: Configure pricing when available
flows.description: Configure pricing when available in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open the pricing settings for an eligible course.
Set the available price and purchase options.
Save and inspect the learner-facing price without making a real payment.
outcomes: The course displays the saved pricing configuration.

flows.title: Enroll and unenroll individual course learners
flows.description: Enroll and unenroll individual course learners in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Enroll and unenroll individual course learners.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open enrolled-user management.
Search, filter and select demo users, then assign the course.
Remove a direct assignment and inspect remaining valid group access.
outcomes: Direct learner assignment follows the selected enrollment changes.

flows.title: Manage group course enrollment and deadlines
flows.description: Manage group course enrollment and deadlines in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Manage group course enrollment and deadlines.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open course group enrollment.
Select a demo group, mandatory or optional assignment, and its available due date.
Change a deadline without changing mandatory status, then demonstrate group removal.
outcomes: Group assignments and deadlines are saved while other valid enrollment is retained.

flows.title: Transfer course ownership
flows.description: Transfer course ownership in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open course ownership management as an authorized administrator.
Choose the new synthetic author and confirm.
Inspect the saved owner.
outcomes: Responsibility is transferred to the selected account.

flows.title: Review course completion and assessment statistics
flows.description: Review course completion and assessment statistics in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Review course completion and assessment statistics.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open Statistics for a course the account may manage.
Inspect progress, completion, learning time, quiz results and available AI Mentor outcomes.
Show how switching to Learning Mode returns to the learner table of contents.
outcomes: Authorized managers can review outcomes without learner-mode access to administration.

flows.title: Share and synchronize a master course
flows.description: Share and synchronize a master course in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Share and synchronize a master course.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open sharing for an eligible master course.
Select a managed synthetic tenant and start the transfer.
Inspect the copied read-only course and a supported source update synchronization.
outcomes: The recipient receives its own managed copy and supported updates.

flows.title: Export and import an editable Mentingo course package
flows.description: Export and import an editable Mentingo course package in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Export and import an editable Mentingo course package.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Download a Mentingo package from the course sharing area.
Choose package import in new-course creation and upload the synthetic ZIP.
Inspect the imported free draft and repeat-import notice.
outcomes: The destination receives its own editable draft without learner enrollments or progress.

flows.title: Export supported course content as SCORM
flows.description: Export supported course content as SCORM in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Export supported course content as SCORM.
preconditions: The synthetic course is manageable by this account; required course-type services are configured.
actions: Open the supported SCORM export action.
Review any warning about unsupported lesson types and confirm the intended export.
Download the resulting package.
outcomes: The SCORM ZIP contains the supported course content.

domains.title: Learning in Courses
domains.description: Enroll, learn, resume lessons, complete assessments and access completion evidence.

flows.title: Inspect a course and self-enroll
flows.description: Inspect a course and self-enroll in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open a course from the catalog and inspect its overview and curriculum.
Choose enrollment on an eligible free published course.
Continue to the first lesson after enrollment.
outcomes: The learner is enrolled and learning progress is initialized.

flows.title: Start and continue learning
flows.description: Start and continue learning in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open an enrolled course.
Choose Start or Continue and inspect the opened lesson.
Leave and return to verify the course resumes its eligible learning state.
outcomes: The appropriate accessible lesson opens.

flows.title: Navigate lessons and understand sequence locks
flows.description: Navigate lessons and understand sequence locks in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Navigate lessons and understand sequence locks.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Use previous, next and sidebar lesson navigation.
Inspect an accessible out-of-order course and a sequence-enabled course.
Complete an earlier requirement and inspect the next unlocked lesson.
outcomes: Lesson access and navigation follow course sequencing rules.

flows.title: Read content and use lesson resources
flows.description: Read content and use lesson resources in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Read content and use lesson resources.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open a content lesson.
Read its authored material and open the attached synthetic resources.
Inspect the lesson completion and chapter progress state.
outcomes: The learner can use the lesson material and see progress.

flows.title: Control lesson video playback
flows.description: Control lesson video playback in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open a lesson video and focus its player.
Use supported play, seek, volume, mute, restart and fullscreen shortcuts.
Return to the lesson without applying shortcuts to other controls.
outcomes: The focused player responds to the supported playback controls.

flows.title: Complete required videos and resume missed content
flows.description: Complete required videos and resume missed content in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Complete required videos and resume missed content.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Watch part of a required-video lesson and inspect watched and missed chunks.
Attempt in-app navigation and choose Continue watching.
Inspect resume at an incomplete video, pause and then complete the required coverage.
outcomes: Saved video coverage, leave warnings and resume state stay aligned.

flows.title: Submit a quiz, review feedback and retake when eligible
flows.description: Submit a quiz, review feedback and retake when eligible in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Submit a quiz, review feedback and retake when eligible.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Answer every required quiz question and submit.
Inspect score and the available correct-answer feedback.
Use a permitted retake and inspect attempt limits or cooldown messaging.
outcomes: Quiz completion and access follow the configured passing and retake rules.

flows.title: Complete an embedded-content lesson
flows.description: Complete an embedded-content lesson in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open an accessible embed lesson.
Use the embedded synthetic training content.
Inspect the lesson-specific completion and next-lesson action.
outcomes: Embedded content participates in the course completion flow.

flows.title: Launch, resume and complete SCORM learning
flows.description: Launch, resume and complete SCORM learning in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Launch, resume and complete SCORM learning.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open a synthetic SCORM lesson.
Navigate its sections, save progress and return to resume.
Complete the required SCOs and inspect Mentingo progress.
outcomes: Runtime state resumes and completion follows the package rules.

flows.title: Use an available AI mentor lesson
flows.description: Use an available AI mentor lesson in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Use an available AI mentor lesson.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open a configured AI mentor lesson.
Follow its displayed conversation task using synthetic prompts.
Inspect the provided lesson outcome and completion state.
outcomes: The learner can follow the configured AI mentor lesson.

flows.title: Access live-training schedule and materials
flows.description: Access live-training schedule and materials in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open an available live-training lesson.
Inspect its schedule, join details and synthetic materials.
Inspect the provided attendance or completion state.
outcomes: The learner can find the live-training information and its recorded outcome.

flows.title: Inspect course and chapter completion
flows.description: Inspect course and chapter completion in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Complete the final eligible demo lesson.
Return to the course overview.
Inspect completed chapter counts, course completion and the available next actions.
outcomes: The course displays the learner's accepted completion.

flows.title: Preview, download and share an earned certificate
flows.description: Preview, download and share an earned certificate in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Preview, download and share an earned certificate.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open an issued course certificate from the course, dashboard or profile.
Select a supported preview language and download its PDF.
Inspect supported public or LinkedIn sharing using synthetic certificate data.
outcomes: The learner can access localized proof of completion.

flows.title: Repeat completed training without losing accepted completion
flows.description: Repeat completed training without losing accepted completion in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Repeat completed training without losing accepted completion.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open a completed enrolled course with repetition enabled.
Choose Repeat course and complete part of its fresh learning state.
Leave and resume the same repetition, then finish its required activity.
outcomes: Accepted completion is retained until the repetition replaces it; qualifying certificate replacement follows issuance.

flows.title: Participate in an enrolled-course discussion
flows.description: Participate in an enrolled-course discussion in Mentingo.
preconditions: The synthetic learner has the required course access and the demonstrated lesson type is configured.
actions: Open the course Chat tab.
Create a synthetic thread, reply, mention an enrolled learner and react.
Delete the account's own disposable message using the provided action.
outcomes: Enrolled participants can discuss training with permission-scoped actions.

domains.title: Knowledge Base Articles
domains.description: Browse, create, organize, localize and maintain knowledge-base articles, including covers and public visibility.

flows.title: Browse and read knowledge-base articles
flows.description: Browse and read knowledge-base articles in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
Published articles with realistic localized content exist.
actions: Open Articles through application navigation.
Browse the section table of contents and open an article in the selected language.
outcomes: The selected article displays its title, summary and rich content.

flows.title: Create an article section
flows.description: Create an article section in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
actions: Open Articles and add a section from the table of contents.
Give the section a realistic localized title and save.
outcomes: The new section appears in the table of contents.

flows.title: Rename and localize an article section
flows.description: Rename and localize an article section in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Rename and localize an article section.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
A disposable article section exists.
actions: Open the section editing controls.
Update its title, add a supported language version and save.
Inspect the section in each selected language.
outcomes: Each language shows its saved section title.

flows.title: Create an article in a section
flows.description: Create an article in a section in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Create an article in a section.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
The content author can manage own articles and a section exists.
actions: Open an expanded section and choose New article.
Open the new article editor, enter a localized title, summary and content, then save.
outcomes: The saved article can be opened from its section and shows the entered content.

flows.title: Edit article title, summary and content
flows.description: Edit article title, summary and content in Mentingo.
flows.goal: Edit article title, summary and content.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
A populated article owned by the recording author exists.
actions: Open the article through the table of contents and choose Edit.
Update the title, summary and rich content, then save.
Reopen the article through navigation.
outcomes: The updated content is displayed and remains saved.

flows.title: Preview article content before saving
flows.description: Preview article content before saving in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
An editable article contains realistic localized rich content.
actions: Open the article editor and edit its rich content.
Switch to the preview tab for the active language.
Return to editing and save the article.
outcomes: The preview renders the active language content and the article can be saved.

flows.title: Maintain multiple article language versions
flows.description: Maintain multiple article language versions in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
An editable article with populated base-language content exists.
actions: Open the language selector and add another supported language.
Edit titles, summaries and content in both languages, switching before saving.
Save once, reopen and inspect each language.
outcomes: Both changed translations remain saved without overwriting each other.

flows.title: Replace an article cover image
flows.description: Replace an article cover image in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
An editable article and a neutral image fixture without written English text are available.
actions: Open the article editor for the selected language.
Choose a cover image through the visible upload control and save.
Return to article details.
outcomes: The article displays the uploaded cover for the selected language.

flows.title: Control public article access
flows.description: Control public article access in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
An article exists; enable the Articles module and public article tenant setting off camera using existing helpers.
actions: Open article editing, enable public access and save.
Show the article in a visitor window.
Return to management, turn public access off and save, then inspect a fresh visitor window.
outcomes: A visitor can read the public article, while the private version is unavailable to visitors.

flows.title: Delete an article
flows.description: Delete an article in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
A disposable synthetic article exists in a section.
actions: Open the disposable article and choose Delete.
Complete the displayed confirmation.
outcomes: The deleted article is no longer listed in its section.

flows.title: Delete an article section
flows.description: Delete an article section in Mentingo.
preconditions: The Articles module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureArticlesModuleEnabled helper; the account has the required article permissions.
A disposable synthetic section exists; do not remove shared demonstration content.
actions: Open the disposable section actions and choose Delete.
Complete the displayed confirmation.
outcomes: The deleted section is absent from the table of contents.

domains.title: News
domains.description: Browse, create, edit, publish, localize and maintain news posts, including media and public visibility.

flows.title: Browse and read company news
flows.description: Browse and read company news in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
Several published news posts with realistic localized content exist.
actions: Open News through application navigation and browse the available posts.
Open a post, read its content and use its table of contents or previous/next navigation when available.
outcomes: The learner can read published updates in the selected language and navigate between posts.

flows.title: Create a news draft
flows.description: Create a news draft in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
actions: Open News and choose the create action.
Enter a realistic localized title, summary and rich content.
Save with Draft status and reopen the draft as its author.
outcomes: The saved draft retains its content and is not shown in a learner window.

flows.title: Edit a news post
flows.description: Edit a news post in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
A populated news post owned by the recording author exists.
actions: Open the post and choose Edit.
Update the title, summary and rich content, then save.
Reopen the post through navigation.
outcomes: The updated content remains saved.

flows.title: Publish a news draft
flows.description: Publish a news draft in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
An owned draft has a title and content in every active language.
actions: Open the draft editor, select Published status and save.
Switch to a learner window and open the newly published post through News.
outcomes: Learners can find and read the published update in the selected language.

flows.title: Return published news to draft
flows.description: Return published news to draft in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
A disposable published post owned by the author is visible to a learner.
actions: Open post editing, change its status to Draft and save.
Show the manager draft view, then inspect a fresh learner view.
outcomes: The author retains the editable draft while the learner list no longer shows it.

flows.title: Maintain multiple news language versions
flows.description: Maintain multiple news language versions in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
An editable news post has populated base-language content.
actions: Open the editor language selector and add another supported language.
Enter localized title, summary and content, switching languages before saving.
Save once, reopen and inspect both translations.
outcomes: Both changed translations remain saved without overwriting each other.

flows.title: Preview unsaved news content
flows.description: Preview unsaved news content in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
An editable news post has realistic localized rich content.
actions: Open post editing and change its rich content.
Switch to the Preview tab for the active language.
Return to editing and save.
outcomes: The preview displays the unsaved active-language content, and the saved post retains it.

flows.title: Replace a news cover image
flows.description: Replace a news cover image in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
An editable news post and a neutral image fixture without written English text are available.
actions: Open news editing for the selected language.
Choose a cover through the visible image upload control and save.
Return to the news detail view.
outcomes: The news post displays its new cover for the selected language.

flows.title: Add supporting media to news
flows.description: Add supporting media to news in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
An editable news post and a small neutral supported image or document fixture are available.
actions: Open the rich-content editor and use its visible resource upload control.
Add the supporting resource, preview the content and save.
Open the post detail view.
outcomes: The saved post displays or links the uploaded supporting resource.

flows.title: Control public news access
flows.description: Control public news access in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
A published localized news post exists; enable public News access off camera using existing content-feature helpers.
actions: Open news editing, enable public visibility and save.
Show the post in a visitor window.
Return to management, turn public visibility off and save, then inspect a fresh visitor window.
outcomes: Visitors can read the public published post, while the private version is unavailable to them.

flows.title: Delete a news post
flows.description: Delete a news post in Mentingo.
preconditions: The News module is enabled off camera with the existing ensureNewsModuleEnabled helper; the recording account has the required news permissions.
A disposable synthetic news post exists; do not delete shared demonstration posts.
actions: Open the disposable news post and choose Delete.
Complete the displayed confirmation.
outcomes: The deleted post is no longer listed.
